rubric.surface: Credited artist surface; fine anatomy and optical fidelity incomplete

assessment.shape: Rounded cetacean body, contrasting ventrum/eye patches, dorsal fin and horizontal flukes are distinct from both sharks. Head profile, flipper breadth, sex, age and ecotype remain insufficiently established from the creator asset. The reference is a different individual and source-labelled Bigg’s form.
assessment.surface: Continuous retained atlas and source normal detail; no skin-patch collage or schematic substitution. Strong highlights and fine skin pattern remain artist interpretations. Wet-skin optics are not quantitatively calibrated.
assessment.motion: Vertical posterior deformation inspected at 0.25 and 1.15 display seconds from side/front/top. The anterior body remains comparatively stable and the same UV surface resets. Independent pectoral-flipper phasing, propulsion, speed, muscle action, breathing and sleep are absent.
changes: Original credited artist body and embedded textures bundled.
Authored continuous posterior bending in a vertical plane; no body-size scaling.
Aquatic display clearance and broader anatomy framing; surface-linked approximate landmarks.
Explicit NOAA/SMM versus MDD taxonomic-concept warning; occurrence map withheld.
remaining: Head and pectoral-fin proportions need specialist comparison to identified sex/age/ecotype.
Body dimensions and source texture are not measured from an animal.
Full population-specific foraging, sound production, physiological sleep and hydrodynamics remain unavailable.

photograph.author: steve b (iNaturalist uploader)
photograph.description: An authentic breaching killer whale from a community-identified iNaturalist observation. Its taxon is recorded as O. orca rectipinnus by that platform; it illustrates the disclosed broad NOAA/SMM concept, not MDD’s narrower O. orca concept.
photograph.identityScope: The photographed animal is source-labelled as the Bigg’s form. Used only under the explicitly disclosed broad NOAA/SMM O. orca treatment. Creator model is not identified to ecotype.
photograph.changes: Faithful resize and JPEG encoding; no generated content, anatomical edits or color replacement.

originalAccess.scope: Original-resolution URL derived from the source photo URL; original retrieval timed out. The actual downloaded source is the openly licensed large derivative at downloadUrl; downloadSha256 covers that exact derivative, not inaccessible original-resolution bytes.

model.changes: The same credited surface bends primarily in the posterior body and moves the horizontal flukes vertically. The anterior region remains comparatively stable. Timing and amplitude are authored; flipper phasing, flow, energetic cost and muscle activity are not modeled.
